findings.title: Popen.kill performs another OS poll after the retained eligibility clock sample
findings.trigger: Cap/deadline failure; final explicit None poll and shared sample pass; internal send_signal poll then consumes the remaining interval and returns None.
findings.impact: Actual KILL can follow an unchecked internal waitpid after the last sample. If internal poll sees exit, kill returns without signalling but kill_delivered is set true.
findings.minimal_repair: Use an audited direct retained-child signal operation without an internal poll or query; keep the actual None poll immediately followed by shared clock and both strict end predicates, one attempt and original wait remainder; record syscall return accurately.
findings.scope: New COPY collect implementation; no whole dependency verdict reassignment

findings.title: Failed receipt schema rejects truthful negative signal exit codes
findings.trigger: Allowed KILL is actually reaped with signal return code, or child independently exits by signal before status collection.
findings.impact: Candidate preserves the real signed code, but the required FAILED_UNVERIFIED receipt violates helper_collection/caller_collection actual_exit and potentially kill_eligibility_exit domains.
findings.minimal_repair: Allow signed integer or null for the two exit fields in all failure-capable child definitions. Preserve nonnegative clocks/counts/PIDs and explicit success exit0 gates.
findings.evidence: schema-observations.json; source observe_exit200-206, collect822-837 and receipt1184-1213
findings.scope: Candidate full receipt schema and failure evidence
